S.FORM: alang Paridrayan ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Santimon go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 229 buwan, 733 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 718 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 15 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 95%, Rukay 1%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Paridrayan hya' ga Tjusepayuan. tay 'zil na Paridrayan hya' ga Cavak. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san "tuqi'"qu spzyang glgang nha qalang musa' ana inu'. basu kisya' glgan ungat kisya' nya'. spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ pari*rajan ɣa nija mki s~ɕku ħeto keŋ atu s~ɕantimon ɣo, kwara s~ɕali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan, *** ħi ku kwara s~ɕʔuli tajan. s~ɕʔuli tajan pins~ɕpŋan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa **% kjan ku *** ħi, βinaħ ɣa, ʔjat kaħun s~ɕku pins~ɕpŋan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa *% kjan ku ** ħi nja. pins~ɕpuŋ na linħujan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa, pajwan **%, rukaj *%, βunun *%, βinaħ liħujan s~ɕʔuli *%. rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na pari*rajan ħjaʔ ɣa tjus~ɕepajuan. taj ʔzil na pari*rajan ħjaʔ ɣa ʦ~ʨa*ak. rekis~ɕi kajal kjokaj s~ɕs~ɕquliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwas~ɕan βiru ʔlaqiʔ ʦ~ʨikuj pqwas~ɕan βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkjas~ɕ tuqi ʔs~ɕan "tuqiʔ"qu s~ɕpzjaŋ ɣlɣaŋ nħa qalaŋ mus~ɕaʔ ana inuʔ. βas~ɕu kis~ɕjaʔ ɣlɣan uŋat kis~ɕjaʔ njaʔ. s~ɕpjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
